mission.3.step1.title: The starting point
mission.3.step1.explain: You have a report folder and a two-commit history on the main lane.
mission.3.step2.title: A desk for the “figures” AI
mission.3.step2.explain: A worktree is one more folder linked to the same repository. The AI works there on its own branch, without touching your folder.
mission.3.step2.hint: Start with git worktree add, then the path of the new folder, then -b and the branch name.
mission.3.step3.title: A desk for the “summary” AI
mission.3.step3.explain: Same idea for a second AI: another folder, another branch, the same repository.
mission.3.step3.hint: Same command, with ../rapport-ia-resume and the branch ia/resume.
mission.3.step4.title: See where things stand
mission.3.step4.explain: git worktree list shows each folder and the branch it has open.
mission.3.outro: Three folders, one history. Each moves forward on its own lane without getting in the others' way.
explain.worktree.add: A new folder “{path}” is opened on branch {branch}. The repository stays single.
explain.worktree.list: The list shows each folder and the branch it has open.
explain.commit: A snapshot of the project is saved on the {branch} lane.
explain.add: {file} is staged: it will be part of the next snapshot.
explain.branch: A new lane {name} starts from the current commit.
explain.switch: This folder now works on the {name} lane.
explain.squash: {n} commits are folded into one, easier to read.
error.branchInUse: Branch {name} is already open in folder {path}. A branch can live in only one folder at a time.
error.pushRejected: Rejected: the online version has moved on. Fetch the changes first (pull).
error.worktreeDirty: This folder has unsaved changes: it can't be removed.
error.nothingToCommit: Nothing to save: no file is staged.
error.mergeConflict: Conflict: both lanes changed the same file, {file}.
diff.conflict.noDetail: This scenario does not detail the content; in a real project Git would show you the conflicting lines.
puzzle.label: Challenge {n} of 10
puzzle.4.title: Three “wip” into one
puzzle.4.prompt: The AI left three “wip” commits. Fold them into one before sharing.
puzzle.4.goal: A single clean commit on the ia/chiffres lane.
puzzle.4.why.reset: reset --hard erases the work instead of grouping it.
puzzle.4.why.revert: revert adds an undo commit; it doesn't group anything.
puzzle.4.why.merge: merge brings in another lane; it doesn't tidy this one.
puzzle.4.takeaway: rebase -i lets you fold (squash) several commits into one before sharing.
tree.tip: Click a file: modified, then staged, then clean. A folder opens on click. The + adds a file.
diff.title: The diff: what changed
diff.readonly: nothing is changed: we only look
diff.sentence.branches: Here is what assistant 1 changed on its lane, compared with main. Nothing is merged yet.
diff.sentence.work: What you changed but have not staged with git add yet. New files (U) do not show up here.
diff.sentence.staged: What is staged in the index: exactly what will go into the next commit.
diff.empty.untracked: A new file does not show in git diff until it is staged. Run first: git add {file}
mission.3.stepDiff.title: Review its work with diff
mission.3.stepDiff.explain: git diff compares two lanes: removed lines in red, added lines in green. Nothing is changed.
mission.3.stepDiff.hint: Type git diff, then main, then ia/resume.
mission.7.title: A readable history
mission.6.bubbleA: An AI assistant opened MR !42 on its branch ia/graphiques. You are in the middle of your own work. Let’s review its MR the classic way: by switching branches.
mission.6.bubbleB: Same MR, another method: we open a second folder just for the review. Keep an eye on your desk during the whole mission.
mission.6.outroA: It works, but your desk was disturbed during the whole review, and you had to remember stash pop.
mission.6.outroB: Your work never moved. The review folder takes one command to create and is thrown away afterwards.
mission.6.a1.title: Look at your work in progress
mission.6.a1.ex: Before switching branches, check what is in progress.
mission.6.a1.after: Two modified files (M): your work is not saved yet.
mission.6.a2.title: Put your work away
mission.6.a2.ex: Set your work aside so you can switch branches without carrying it along or losing it.
mission.6.a2.after: Your M files are gone from the folder: they are put away in the stash, in zone ③.
mission.6.a2.note: Your work is hidden, not lost.
mission.6.a3.title: Fetch the MR’s branch
mission.6.a3.ex: Download what is online, without touching your folder.
mission.6.a3.after: The MR’s lane now exists on your side, as origin/ia/graphiques.
mission.6.a4.title: Open the MR’s branch
mission.6.a4.ex: Your folder takes the content of the MR’s branch.
mission.6.a4.after: Your folder changed content: the graphiques/ folder appeared. The thread now runs to the blue lane.
mission.6.a4.note: Same folder, different content: you are no longer on main.
mission.6.a5.title: Review with diff
mission.6.a5.ex: Compare the MR’s branch with main: only what the MR brings.
mission.6.a5.after: Two added files (A) and one modified (M). Open the diff screen to read line by line.
mission.6.a6.title: Approve the MR
mission.6.a6.ex: The review is done: give your approval online.
mission.6.a6.after: The MR is approved. It can be merged into main.
mission.6.a7.title: Go back and bring your work out
mission.6.a7.ex: Back to main, then bring the stashed work back.
mission.6.a7.after: You are back on main and your two M files are back. Without stash pop, they would have stayed hidden.
mission.6.b1.title: Fetch the MR’s branch
mission.6.b1.ex: Download what is online, without touching your folder.
mission.6.b1.after: The MR’s lane exists on your side, as origin/ia/graphiques. Your M files did not move.
mission.6.b2.title: Open a review desk
mission.6.b2.ex: A second folder, open on the MR’s branch. No stash needed.
mission.6.b2.after: A new folder revue-mr-42 appeared, linked to the blue lane. Your desk is untouched, at 60%: you now work in the review.
mission.6.b2.note: Your desk did not move: your M files are still there.
mission.6.b3.title: Review with diff
mission.6.b3.ex: In the review folder, compare the MR’s branch with main.
mission.6.b3.after: Two added files (A) and one modified (M). Open the diff screen to read line by line.
mission.6.b4.title: Approve, then merge
mission.6.b4.ex: Give your approval, then the MR is merged into main, online.
mission.6.b4.after: The MR is merged on origin: origin/main moved forward. Your local main has not moved yet.
mission.6.b4.note: Merged online: you will need to fetch it.
mission.6.b5.title: Remove the review desk
mission.6.b5.ex: The review folder has done its job: remove it.
mission.6.b5.after: The review folder is gone. The ia/graphiques branch still exists in the .git.
mission.6.b6.title: Update main
mission.6.b6.ex: In your desk, bring in the merge made online.
mission.6.b6.after: main moved up to the merge, and your two M files are still there: your work was never disturbed.
